summary: Concrete LAN blocker found in UI draft: unconditional crypto.randomUUID is unavailable on ordinary http://LAN-IP origins, before fetch. Please fix/test before M1 acceptance. Also completed training-only alignment residual diagnosis.

findings.trigger: Laptop 2 opens UI at http://192.168.x.x:5173 (ordinary insecure LAN HTTP origin). randomUUID is secure-context-only, so the method may be undefined.
findings.outcome: Every health/trips/predict request fails before fetch; localhost tests can pass because localhost is treated as trustworthy. Existing fetch try/catch begins after request ID generation and does not prevent this failure.
findings.fix: Provide a guarded correlation-ID fallback (e.g. getRandomValues where available) meeting request-ID regex; test randomUUID unavailable/insecure-origin behavior. No need for authentication or TLS infrastructure solely for correlation IDs.

findings.trigger: A finite out-of-range raw GPS coordinate is preserved as status=invalid by the contract (e.g. lat=91); UI only checks null and treats invalid status as normal GPS.
findings.outcome: Invalid coordinate gets sent to Leaflet and styled as ordinary raw point. Invalid timestamp rows with valid coordinates are also indistinguishable from valid GPS.
findings.fix: Check coordinate finiteness/ranges before mapping; keep invalid records in inspector/counts and give a distinct policy if displaying valid-coordinate invalid-time rows.

findings.trigger: Headers arrive promptly but response body stalls; timer cleared before await response.json().
findings.outcome: Advertised request timeout no longer covers body reception/parse; potentially stays loading indefinitely.
findings.fix: Keep timeout active through response consumption, with clear cleanup and timeout errors.

training_only_diagnosis.interpretation: Most excluded labels stem from actual GPS/reference spatial mismatch at the chosen provisional threshold, not candidate/classifier failure. The 558 chronology-conflicting cases need sensitivity/ambiguity reporting. Do not silently widen threshold for flattering coverage or call these official labels.
